items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to make many of his dates with him and Calvin Jackson.

ctx.x: Now Phil Moore was so sad that people didn’t know who he was. Phil Moore was - he’s a black writer, he’s a pianist, he plays piano. He was Lena Horne’s accompanist and her coach for years. He worked already, he was working at MGM, he was working for Nathanial Schilkret. I’m saying names that go way back, now. Phil was my mentor because I met him when I was with Jimmie Lunceford. He liked me, and when I quit and I came back, he liked my trumpet playing. I used to make many of his dates with him and Calvin Jackson.…
